question: Did P0586 stop before a shared optimum in tidal anisotropy or baryonic reach, or do the four raw clusters prefer incompatible continuous-metric responses?

locked_from_p0586.component: absolute ACCEPT gas with sqrt Chandra morphology plus registered F160W stars

factorial.meaning: extend the P0586 tau=0.6 and eta=0.5 boundaries while testing only small scalar leakage around epsilon0=1

validation.screen: hold each eight-start zero-field geometry and source solution fixed and score every candidate separately on all four clusters
validation.selection: choose one candidate using only equal-system source-plane RMS in the original two selection clusters
validation.exact: refit the one selection winner with eight starts on all four systems
validation.diagnostic: also report each cluster's independent best grid point and whether any candidate improves all four fixed-geometry scores
validation.spent_disclosure: all systems are spent and this is response characterization, not independent validation

claim_limits: This extension uses project-spent systems and cannot validate a new law.
The source-plane screen is only a directional diagnostic; exact image roots remain authoritative.
The projected baryonic acceleration proxy and incomplete stellar/ICL mass construction are unchanged from P0586.
A boundary optimum would motivate another scale test, not prove a force law.
